meta.title: ecom-2.0 AisleFlow Prototype
meta.description: First real Modern Grocery storefront slice: WooCommerce + Grovia Core + block theme + demo grocery fixtures.
meta.author: Spidy092

options.blogdescription: A grocery shopping workspace prototype for ecom-2.0.

steps.code:
<?php
require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';

if ( ! class_exists( 'WC_Product_Simple' ) ) {
    throw new RuntimeException( 'WooCommerce product classes are unavailable.' );
}

$home = get_page_by_path( 'home' );
if ( $home ) {
    $home_id = $home->ID;
} else {
    $home_id = wp_insert_post(
        array(
            'post_title'  => 'Home',
            'post_name'   => 'home',
            'post_status' => 'publish',
            'post_type'   => 'page',
        ),
        true
    );

    if ( is_wp_error( $home_id ) ) {
        throw new RuntimeException( $home_id->get_error_message() );
    }
}

update_option( 'show_on_front', 'page' );
update_option( 'page_on_front', (int) $home_id );

$sample = get_page_by_path( 'sample-page' );
if ( $sample ) {
    wp_delete_post( $sample->ID, true );
}

$category_names = array( 'Produce', 'Dairy', 'Pantry', 'Bakery' );
$category_ids   = array();

foreach ( $category_names as $category_name ) {
    $slug = sanitize_title( $category_name );
    $term = get_term_by( 'slug', $slug, 'product_cat' );

    if ( ! $term ) {
        $created = wp_insert_term( $category_name, 'product_cat', array( 'slug' => $slug ) );
        if ( is_wp_error( $created ) ) {
            throw new RuntimeException( $created->get_error_message() );
        }
        $category_ids[ $slug ] = (int) $created['term_id'];
    } else {
        $category_ids[ $slug ] = (int) $term->term_id;
    }
}

$fixtures = array(
    array( 'sku' => 'grovia-demo-milk', 'name' => 'Whole Milk · 1 L', 'price' => '3.20', 'category' => 'dairy' ),
    array( 'sku' => 'grovia-demo-eggs', 'name' => 'Free Range Eggs · 6', 'price' => '4.40', 'category' => 'dairy' ),
    array( 'sku' => 'grovia-demo-tomatoes', 'name' => 'Tomatoes · 1 kg', 'price' => '2.90', 'category' => 'produce' ),
    array( 'sku' => 'grovia-demo-bananas', 'name' => 'Bananas · 1 kg', 'price' => '2.50', 'category' => 'produce' ),
    array( 'sku' => 'grovia-demo-rice', 'name' => 'Everyday Rice · 2 kg', 'price' => '7.80', 'category' => 'pantry' ),
    array( 'sku' => 'grovia-demo-lentils', 'name' => 'Red Lentils · 1 kg', 'price' => '5.60', 'category' => 'pantry' ),
    array( 'sku' => 'grovia-demo-bread', 'name' => 'Wholegrain Bread · 500 g', 'price' => '3.70', 'category' => 'bakery' ),
    array( 'sku' => 'grovia-demo-rolls', 'name' => 'Breakfast Rolls · 4', 'price' => '3.10', 'category' => 'bakery' )
);

foreach ( $fixtures as $index => $fixture ) {
    $existing_id = wc_get_product_id_by_sku( $fixture['sku'] );
    $product     = $existing_id ? wc_get_product( $existing_id ) : new WC_Product_Simple();

    if ( ! $product ) {
        continue;
    }

    $product->set_name( $fixture['name'] );
    $product->set_status( 'publish' );
    $product->set_catalog_visibility( 'visible' );
    $product->set_regular_price( $fixture['price'] );
    $product->set_sku( $fixture['sku'] );
    $product->set_stock_status( 'instock' );
    $product->set_menu_order( $index );
    $product->set_category_ids( array( $category_ids[ $fixture['category'] ] ) );
    $product->save();
}
